name: Slate
css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: var(--docent-shadow); } .title { letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .button { border-radius: 10px; } .button.primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(62% 0.2 268), var(--docent-accent)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.25), 0 1px 2px oklch(30% 0.15 268 / 0.4), 0 4px 12px -2px oklch(54% 0.22 268 / 0.45); } .button.primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(66% 0.2 268), oklch(57% 0.22 268)); } .meter { width: 44px; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(var(--docent-accent), var(--docent-accent)) 0 0 / calc(var(--docent-step) / var(--docent-steps) * 100%) 100% no-repeat, oklch(21% 0.02 265 / 0.08); }
